name: Hotel Cafe Royal
positioning: Historic Regent Street hotel, officially Hotel Café Royal, where St. James's, Mayfair and Soho meet, with rooms and suites designed by Sir David Chipperfield
best_for: Travelers who want a West End base on Regent Street
Suite guests who want a daily chauffeur
Spa-goers, with complimentary gym, pool and wellness classes

facts.text: The hotel is on Regent Street, where St. James's, Mayfair and Soho converge.
Chef Alex Dilling offers a modern take on traditional French gastronomic cuisine at the hotel.
Akasha is the hotel's subterranean spa.
All guests receive complimentary access to the gym, pool and wellness classes.
The hotel's event spaces include a Grade II-listed ballroom.
The Superior Rooms and the suites are designed by Sir David Chipperfield.
Superior Rooms sit in the eaves of the hotel and look out to London's rooftops.
The Club Suite's living room keeps original red and gold gildings.
The Two Bedroom Tudor Suite is a historic suite that evokes the Elizabethan era.
The Westminster Suites have views of London landmarks such as Piccadilly Circus, Westminster, St James and Regent Street.
Guests in a Deluxe Suite or higher get a chauffeur for up to 5 hours a day on the days between arrival and departure.
Suite stays include a Laundered Luggage Service that cleans suitcases to standards set by TUMI.

highlights.text: For over 160 years, Café Royal has welcomed guests from Oscar Wilde and Winston Churchill to Princess Diana and David Bowie.
The Celestine Suite is named after Celestine Nichols, wife of Café Royal's founder.
The Celestine Suite is one of Café Royal's original spaces, meticulously restored with golden gilding details.
Cakes & Bubbles serves desserts and pastries by pastry chef Albert Adrià, with a wide selection of Champagne and sparkling wine.
Royal Suite and Dome Penthouse guests can be driven in a Rolls Royce.

considerations.text: The suite inclusions, such as the chauffeur, are available when booking direct.
Rates are subject to a 5% discretionary service charge.
WhataHotel notes a busy central location with high foot traffic.

sources.title: Hotel Café Royal - A Suite Journey
